boundary: Repository-local evidence is not external enterprise control evidence.

controls.evidence: Trusted identity provider and account lifecycle records are adopter-owned.
Least privilege and access policy are adopter-owned.
Repository PR evidence supports review but does not configure branch protection.
Provider branch rules require adopter/provider evidence.
Signature policy and verification require provider/adopter evidence.
Immutable distribution storage and retention are external.
Runtime and provider permissions require adopter configuration evidence.
Secret storage, rotation, and scanning policy are external.
Retention, legal hold, and immutable audit storage are external.
Data classification and handling policy are adopter-owned.
Provider terms and data-transfer controls require external evidence.
Incident response ownership and execution are external.
Legal hold and discovery controls are external.
Repository SBOM generation is evidence input, not adopter retention or review proof.
Repository provenance checks do not prove adopter deployment provenance.
Scanner output is time-bound evidence and does not prove absence of vulnerabilities.
